name: Maggot Pit AP OLD

stealth.note: (the maggots are slow and impossible to miss)

description: Countless human-faced, fanged maggots wriggle and squirm in this chamber.
disable: Three DC 45 Religion checks within the room to utter prayers, which calm and quell the maggots with invocations to the gods
reset: The pit functions continuously. If it's disabled or destroyed, it resets automatically after 24 hours if the crystal stele in area M2 still functions, otherwise it doesn't reset.
routine: (2 actions; death, divine, necromancy) On its initiative, the pit uses its first action to use Damning Swarm against any creature within 5 feet of the pit floor. It then takes its second action to form a long, thrashing tendril composed of thousands of maggots to lash at a single target within area M1.

generalAbilities.name: Damning Swarm
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger a creature appears in area M1

Effect The swarming maggots squirm into a biting frenzy, and all creatures on the ground in area M1 must attempt a DC 40 Fortitude Saving Throw save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes (1d10+5) Piercing Damage damage, 3d6 Poison Damage damage, and is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature takes (2d10+10) Piercing Damage damage, 6d6 Poison Damage damage, is sickened 1, and is Enfeebled 1 by the maggots' bites.

Critical Failure The creature takes (4d10+20) Piercing Damage damage, 12d6 Poison Damage damage, is sickened 1, and is Enfeebled 2 by the maggots' bites.
